title: TTHE:固定分支角色与回滚闸门(移植)
note: 移植的是 TTHE 每轮的决策规则:按 DIVERSITY[round_index % 3] 固定分支角色,子代必须通过有效性闸门并留下 proposal card,任何失败一律回退到现任——现任永远是可接受的结果,所以按构造不会退步。没有移植它的 G×R 同批候选池与 agentic judge、transductive 评分协议,以及反译/蜕变一致性这两个需要答案键的 label-free 代理:mode A 每轮只暴露一个候选,方法也不允许给自己打分。

deviations.what: The `G x R` pool and the agentic judge are not expressible.
deviations.why: The judge re-runs and probes the database and is explicitly not `argmax(score)`; rewriting it as one would invent a decision TTHE does not make.

deviations.what: Rejection moves from 'after executing the child, fall back to the parent' to 'do not spend the round'.
deviations.why: Every failure path returns the incumbent with `changed: false`, which keeps the gate's cannot-regress meaning.
